fusions.name: Ferrule Blade
fusions.desc: You flick out the blade hidden in the foot of the staff at an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using it up. It deals 8 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fan From the Hollow
fusions.desc: You shake 3 blades out of the hollow staff in a fan out to 7 tiles. Each deals 26 damage, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Only a Walking Stick
fusions.desc: You lean on the staff and pass for a harmless traveller. For 6 seconds you are veiled and move 10% faster; enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge Out Unseen
fusions.desc: When you lay a condition on an enemy, the staff's hidden edge is out: your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
